GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.77 (6 Mar 48) CCS
SCAPIN 1215/1
APO 500
6 March 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
SUBJECT : Authorization of Radiotelegraph Newscast Service from Japan
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government file AG 000.77(18 Sep 48) CCS, SCAPIN 1216, dated 18 September 1945,subject as above.
2. Telegraph 1b of the reference memorandum is hereby rescinded and the following substituted is lied thereof:
Transmissions on frequencies 8175, 12275 and 15945 kilocycles with maximum power output of 10 kilowatts on each frequency , using A-1 type emission with transmissions beamed to cover East Asia and South China Sea areas.
3. Direct communication between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers and the Ministry of Communications, pertaining to technical details within the scope of this memorandum, is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
AG. Rehe
For R. M. Levy
Colonel, AGD
Adjutant General
